title: あなたが輝くステージを

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that we've decided to rethink our project…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We call a meeting with all the students who've joined our cause, but…

text_block_list.name: Supporter A
text_block_list.text: Er, my friend said she's busy today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Okay, thank you for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Right. I'm sure you're all wondering why we called you here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Well, we want to take another look at what the Grand Concert means to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: As for myself, I've always viewed it as a chance for all runners to convey their gratitude. Meanwhile…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see it as a unique chance to do things we couldn't do in a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Supporter A
text_block_list.text: What kind of things?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well… I'm not really sure yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, have the deliberations begun without me?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Tachyon…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: There's something you're keeping a secret from us, isn't there, Hello?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: A secret? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: About your past. How you used to be a backup dancer?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: She told us about that while you were gone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did she now! For free? You're telling me my deal with Shakur was for nothing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well that's a disappointment… I suppose you've heard about the one she admired so dearly too, then?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Who?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? Ohoho? The curious look on your face suggests otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see… Tell us, then, Hello—you had someone you looked up to very much, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Someone just like you, who retired without ever attaining center stage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: Heh, absolutely dazzling, wasn't I? …As a backup dancer, like always.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: The people cheering for me… they'll cheer for me no matter where on stage I'm standing. I owe it to them to always give 100%, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: I was going to win… and sing my thanks to them… Today was supposed to be the day!

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text: Why… why can't I just—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …Yes, I did. She was brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And how did you feel about her?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Well, I wanted to see her center stage, but… in the end, she didn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Haha! How very egotistical of you! Yes, it's just as I predicted!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Egotistical…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, aren't you just exceptional! And in an entirely different way than Suzuka! You will make the ultimate sample of a fan!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A fan?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Hello… what does the Grand Concert mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It means… Well, um…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want you to answer not as a runner, but as a fan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I've… realized that concerts mean different things depending on who you are and where you stand—on or off the stage.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I always thought of concerts as a space to convey the gratitude I feel when racing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: As long as I got that across, as long as I performed, that was enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Now I know that concerts are a space for me to be "welcomed home" by my fans.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Concerts mean something different to everyone. I'm sure our fans see them differently from us.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: H-hold on. Sorry, this is a lot to take in all at once!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I, um…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …You were a fan, weren't you? You wanted to see that special someone on stage.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: N-no, you're… you're right. I see…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Please, if there's anyone listening up there, don't let her tears be shed in vain.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (Because if she just had a chance, I know it'd be a magical concert like no other…)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to see her up there… That's all I ever wanted.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …What's this? Did you only now realize where you stand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, never mind. The real experiment is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What I seek is empirical proof of the potential generated by a concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The potential not to exceed limits, but to expand them. If we are to continually reach for the untrodden and the unknown, then we must make investments in our futures like this!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Should you attempt to reach the domain that lies beyond on your own, you may exceed your "limits."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let the experiment begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We now know what the Grand Concert means to the students, but what about the fans?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is the next question we must tackle.
